facts.text: The hotel is in Mayfair, at the junction of Conduit Street and Bond Street.
facts.excerpt: The St. Regis London stands as Mayfair's gathering place for art, fashion and influence, at the junction of Conduit Street and Bond Street.

facts.text: The hotel is set amongst London's designer boutiques, art galleries and dining and social hubs.
facts.excerpt: set amongst London's designer boutiques, leading art galleries and extensive dining and social hubs

facts.text: Le Perroquet is an all-day French brasserie by Chef Daniel Rose.
facts.excerpt: Le Perroquet is an all-day brasserie by renowned Chef Daniel Rose, where authentic French cuisine, colourful characters and classic service come together.

facts.text: Le Perroquet is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner, with a smart casual dress code.
facts.excerpt:
Open for breakfast, lunch and dinner

Dress Code:
Smart Casual

facts.text: The hotel's bar, The Regis, is debuting soon and is planned to feature live jazz and mixology.
facts.excerpt: The Regis inspired bar with live jazz and masterful mixology, soon to debut

facts.text: The hotel has two spa suites and a fully equipped gym.
facts.excerpt: the destination offers two indulgent spa suites, a fully equipped gym

facts.text: Hotel rituals include the St. Regis Butler Service, Champagne Sabering and Midnight Suppers, inspired by the Astor legacy and Caroline Astor.
facts.excerpt: from the signature St. Regis Butler Service to Champagne Sabering and Midnight Suppers, each inspired by the storied Astor legacy and the enduring spirit of Caroline Astor herself

facts.text: Rooms have generous windows with views of Bond and Conduit Streets.
facts.excerpt: Generous windows with sweeping views of Bond and Conduit Streets.

facts.text: Rooms come with fine linens, a pillow menu and selected in-room refreshments.
facts.excerpt: Curated comforts: fine linens, pillow menu, and carefully selected in-room refreshments.

facts.text: Rooms are designed with contemporary glamour reflecting Mayfair's fashion, art and cultural spirit.
facts.excerpt: Designed with contemporary glamour, reflecting Mayfair’s fashion, art and cultural spirit.

facts.text: The Penthouse Suite is the largest-occupancy room, for up to 6 guests.
facts.excerpt: The largest occupancy room at The St. Regis London is the Penthouse Suite with a maximum occupancy of 6.

facts.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
facts.excerpt: No, rooms at The St. Regis London do not have a fridge.

facts.text: Pets are welcome: one pet per room up to 25kg, with a non-refundable fee.
facts.excerpt: 1 pets 25kg max per pet per room with non-refundable fee
